frontmatter.title: AWS Global Infrastructure Explained: Regions, Availability Zones, Data Centers, and Edge Locations
frontmatter.subheading: A practical architect's guide to how AWS structures the physical planet into regions, zones, data centers, and edge networks-and what that means for the systems you build.
